Title: Driver extension for Cassandra in Azure Cosmos DB is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB now offers a preview driver extension for Azure Cosmos DB Cassandra API for Java SDK. The driver extension provides retry policies for developers to handle rate limitations using the Cassandra API for Azure Cosmos DB. This library provides functionality similar to the Azure Cosmos DB spark helper. Visit GitHub to download, explore the extension, and provide feedback on the issues list today.

Learn more about Azure Cosmos DB spark helper

Visit GitHub
